borders.label: 边框 1 - Border 1
borders.description: Audible's iOS app is a literary listening room rendered in software. The canvas is a warm charcoal (`#1A1A1A`) — not the cold pure-black of music apps, but a deep, paper-at-night gray that frames book covers like a well-lit shelf. Surfaces step up to `#2A2A2A` for cards and the player chrome, with `#3A3A3A` hairline dividers. The mood is calm, premium, and unhurried — this is an app for hours-long sessions, so it avoids visual urgency. Audiobook cover art is the chromatic hero; the UI recedes into warm darkness so the artwork (and the act of reading-by-ear) takes the foreground.

borders.label: 边框 2 - Border 2
borders.description: The accent system is a single confident orange. Audible Orange (`#FF9900`) — the Amazon-family amber — is reserved for the primary action: the play affordance, progress fill, the active chapter, and the primary CTA. A pressed orange (`#E68A00`) handles tap-down. There is no second brand hue. White (`#FFFFFF`) is primary text; a soft gray (`#B0B0B0`) carries author names, narrator credits, and metadata. The orange is the verb; everything else is the warm, quiet room around it.

panels.title: 以产品流程为中心
panels.body: 适合在 390×844 画布中预览的移动产品体验。

panels.title: 颜色与字体可复用
panels.body: 页面从本地 metadata 与 Design.md 提取 palette、typography 和标签，用于快速预览主题质感。

panels.title: 面向真实界面片段
panels.body: 按钮、输入、卡片和间距样例保持克制，便于比较不同主题的系统性差异。

do: 建议：Use a warm charcoal canvas ({#1A1A1A}) — a paper-at-night reading room, not cold black。
建议：Reserve Audible Orange ({#FF9900}) for the primary action, progress, active chapter, and CTA。
建议：Pair Playfair Display (titles/headers) with Inter (body/UI) — and keep the roles strict。
建议：Use the {gobackward.30} / {goforward.30} skip controls flanking a 72pt orange Play。
建议：Wrap the player cover in an orange circular progress ring。
dont: 避免：use cold pure-black — Audible's warmth ({#1A1A1A}) is the literary signature。
避免：set body or metadata in the serif — Playfair Display is headings/titles only。
避免：add a second accent color — orange is the entire system。
避免：use generic ±10s skip — the 30-second skip is Audible's signature transport。
避免：use full-pill buttons — Audible buttons are 8pt rounded rects。
